d:
Watch ‘Kaara Aattakaara’ from O Kadhal Kanmani sung by Aaryan Dinesh Kanagaratnam, Darshana & Shashaa Tirupati. The simple yet beautifully structured song hits you like a chill breeze, with lyrics by Aaryan Dinesh Kanagaratnam, Mani Ratnam & A.R. Rahman.
Song Name - Kaara Aattakkaara
Movie - O Kadhal Kanmani
Singer - Aaryan Dinesh Kanagaratnam, Darshana & Shashaa Tirupati
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Aaryan Dinesh Kanagaratnam, Mani Ratnam, A.R. Rahman
Director - Mani Ratnam
Starring - Dulquer Salmaan, Nithya Menen
